messages:
Alice Chen: Hey all — posting the company-level OKR draft for FYQ4 here, want to get a rapid alignment and any vetoes before EOD tomorrow. Link: https://redwood-internal/okrs/annual-draft :point_right:
Samir Kapoor: Thanks Alice. Quick q: do the revenue KRs assume Dedicated renewals or hosted expansion as primary driver?
Alice Chen: It's split 60/40 hosted : hosted growth + upsells, Dedicated renewals. We called that out in the assumptions section.
Dana (PM): Can we call out customer-driven asks that must be in scope for the roadmap? e.g., FedRAMP checklist, SSO token lifetime, and per-route billing? Those were flagged by Sales.
Alice Chen: Good call. I'll append a short "must-have customer asks" list. Proposed: FedRAMP prep (Q4 research), SSO token lifetime config (Q4), per-route billing pilot (Q1).
Frank H: For launch criteria on the Dedicated reliability KR, I want explicit SLO thresholds. Suggest: p99 latency <= 200ms for standard gen, error rate < 0.1% over 24h, and rollout canary for 48h with automated rollback.
Olivia R: +1 on the SLOs. Also recommend tightening the definition for "latency-sensitive" workloads vs "batch" so routing policy changes don't break SLAs.
Samir Kapoor: Tradeoffs: if we push per-route billing into Q1, we free up two sprint cycles to focus on KV cache improvements that reduce token cost by ~8% per request. Which is higher ROI?
Dana (PM): Sales says per-route billing is a blocker for 2 enterprise deals (~$600k ARR). KV cache improvements are high impact but not immediate blocker. Suggest we prioritize per-route billing for a narrow pilot (subset of routes + 2 customers) in Q4 and schedule broader KV work in Q1.
Alice Chen: That aligns with my read. Let's define a narrow scope for per-route billing: 1) UI flag in Console, 2) route-level meter + tags, 3) guarded rollout (canary customers). Anything else?
Frank H: Add escape hatch: if telemetry shows >5% revenue risk on pilot, pause and escalate.
pm-bot: Document updated: https://redwood-internal/okrs/annual-draft (v2) — added customer asks and launch criteria.
Olivia R: On scope negotiation: if engineering capacity is limited, can we table non-blocking enhancements (e.g., additional optimization knobs in Console) to post-launch?
Samir Kapoor: Agree. Also let's quantify effort: per-route billing pilot = 3 engs x 6 weeks, KV cache baseline improvements = 4 engs x 8 weeks. We should include that in the signoff doc.
Dana (PM): I'll add an effort estimate table and update the rollout plan. Can we get a final OK from execs by Friday so we can publish to the Org on Monday?
Alice Chen: Requesting quick thumbs: do we have alignment to lock these as company OKRs for signoff Friday? :thumbsup::thumbsdown:
Frank H: :thumbsup: assuming canary SLOs are documented.
Olivia R: :thumbsup: with the scope caveats we discussed.
Samir Kapoor: :thumbsup: prioritizing per-route billing pilot first.
Dana (PM): :thumbsup: I'll capture all these decisions in the draft and share final doc link here.
Alice Chen: Great — thanks everyone. If no objections before EOD tomorrow I will treat this as the signoff and send to execs.
